Strategy Optimizer tab shows Entry Thresholds, Exit Thresholds, Position Sizing, Strategy Weights
RL Learning tab shows Training Iterations, Exploration Rate, Q-Table Analysis, Action Distribution
Paper Trade navigation link exists in header and navigates correctly
